searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "X1/P1 Series Nozzle" panel and the compatibility rows "P1 Series Hotend" / "P1 Series Complete Hotend Assembly" name this product. It agrees with the store page on the sizes ("Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm"), the materials ("Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel") and the max temperature (320 ℃); the per-option diameter and material stay with the store page's option values (official_variant). It states no dimensions, weight, flow rate or electrical value for this product. "P1S comes standard with a 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle" describes the printer, and the 300°C rating of the "X1/P1 Series Hotend Silicone Sock" belongs to that separate product; neither is stored here. Not listed as not_published: the hotend's max flow and filament diameter (the cached P1S tech-spec PDF gives the P1S printer "Max Hot End Flow" 32 mm³/s @ABS and "Filament Diameter 1.75 mm": printer values, not stored here, so "not published by the manufacturer" would mislead), and a shipment gross weight (the store page's "Packaging Weight" is stored as package.weight).

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (it includes high-flow columns this product does not have), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this product; it is used only to flag disagreements with the store page's own Filament Compatibility table (see the relations' conflict notes). Its nozzle guidelines also say to avoid stainless steel for particle-filled filaments (PLA Marble, PLA Sparkle), while the store table marks hardened steel "Optional" for them; on this product the only stainless option (0.2 mm) is "*NO" for those rows, so no relation is affected.
